rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before proceeding. It then retrieved the user’s orders, asked which order to change, checked the order’s details and status, and confirmed the exact address change (from Suite 640 to Suite 641 at the same address) before performing any modification. The order was pending, allowing the change. After receiving explicit confirmation, the agent executed the update via the proper tool and provided accurate final confirmation. No unsupported claims were made, no writes occurred without confirmation, and actions were limited to the authenticated user’s own order. All steps align with policy.
